## Update 1.3.4 Beta 4

**Bug Fixes:**
* Certificates show their team name and team ID instead of a long device ID when they don't have a nickname
* The Updates page only shows release notes when there's a newer version, so What's New isn't repeated
* Signing, download and update panels use the same lighter glass as the tab bar
* During updates, the Semi Local install page waits for any alert on screen to close, so it always appears
* Widgets keep updating if Feather started before the phone was first unlocked
* Semi Local installs over cellular work on carriers that give phones unusual network addresses
